segments.title: BUILT FROM A PLAN, CHECKED BY A STRANGER

sources.text: On 7 October, J's small interactive toy was built from a written plan and put online for testing. It has room drawings, tap reactions, and lines that appear as it is used.

The build was checked before it was called done. A test browser ran 49 automatic checks, and all of them passed with no errors. A fresh reviewer, who had not built the toy, graded it against the plan and found one real bug: a line could be cut off after the app sat open for a long time. The fix was made, and the reviewer checked it too.

sources.text: Not every try worked. Three design options came back looking almost the same, because the same instructions were sent to each builder. The lesson is now saved as a note, so future sessions read it before they make options to choose from.
